description: Picks one channel out of a polyphonic signal, with the choice made by a second voltage, and repeats the pick once for each channel of that voltage

inputs.text: The polyphonic signal to choose from; how many channels are patched here sets how the select voltage is divided up
Chooses which channel to pass: 0V to 10V is shared evenly among the channels present at INPUT, and 10V is added to a negative voltage before the choice is made

outputs.text: Carries the chosen channel of INPUT, with one channel for every channel patched to SELECT

notes: a green lamp marks a channel of INPUT that is being passed and a red lamp marks one that is present but unchosen, the green growing brighter the more select channels land on it

inputs.1:
0 to 10V · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V.
